newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM shares strong as investors return.
newsitem.headline: KLM shares strong as investors return.

text.p: Shares in KLM Royal Dutch Airlines were up 3.70 guilders, or seven percent, to 57.00 on Friday as bargain hunters picked up to the stock, which was heavily sold in Thursday's market shakeout.
Dealers said there was no news behind the move other than a large seller on Thursday had knocked the share down to an attractive price. KLM closed Thursday down 2.70 at 53.30.
"It was oversold yesterday and we're now seeing the buyers coming back," one dealer said.
The AEX recovered strongly on Friday, up around 17 points, having plunged nearly 25 points on Thursday to end at 710.31.
